visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man with short black hair wearing a blue collared shirt holds his hands up to his face, showcasing intricate nail art. He smiles and squints his eyes, looking directly at the camera. Yellow and white text overlays are visible at the bottom. (2) A person holds a small, yellow plush dog toy wearing a green Christmas tree costume with red ornaments. The background is a bokeh-filled night scene of city lights. (3) A shot of the exterior of 'Kantima Salon,' a white-framed building with bright interior lights. A woman in a grey coat and blue jeans walks into the shop through a pink door. (4) Inside the colorful salon, a hand reaches into a basket of circular nail art sample wheels. The samples feature various vibrant patterns, flowers, and characters. (5) Close-up shots of a manicure session: a technician uses a metal nail file on a customer's fingernail, then a motorized nail drill. Another shot shows the technician using a fine brush to paint a Santa Claus design on a thumb. (6) The man from the first phase shows his completed nails, which include a snowman and a reindeer. He is in front of a mirror, holding his hands up while making facial expressions. (7) A female customer shows her nails, decorated with hamburgers and floral patterns, smiling at the camera. The background shows the decorated shop interior with letters on the wall. (8) The final scene returns to the plush toy dog held against the festive night lights, with brand information appearing on the screen.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: Linear: Hook -> Introduction -> Process -> Results -> Recommendation
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video serves as a travel recommendation and lifestyle vlog highlighting a popular nail salon in Bangkok, Kantima Salon. It aims to showcase the detailed service, diverse Christmas-themed designs, and positive experience to encourage viewers to visit during their trip.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: The video focuses entirely on the salon experience, mentions the price, location, and provides clear branding and a call to action to visit.
